spans.s: क्व क्व, ind. (fr. 1. कु; according to Pāṇ.

, formed first fr. किम् and then
fr. the substitute कु with affix अत्), where? in what
place? whither? how? when? (rarely) how much
less! [cf. कुतस्]; connected with the particles इद्,
स्विद्, नु, &c., in the same manner as 2. क, q. v.
(e. g. क्व नु ते क्षत्रियाः शूराः, where now are
those Kṣatriya heroes ?); क्व appears to be used as
a loc. of 2. क in Manu

. (e. g. क्व श्रेयस्-
त्वम्, in whom is the preference?); क्व with भू,
अस्, or गत, may denote, how is it with? what has
become of? (e. g. क्व अहम् भवानि, what will
become of me? क्व गतस् तव मय्य् अनुरागः,
what has become of your affection for me?), or क्व
alone may have the same meaning (e. g. क्व सुखम्,
where is happiness? i. e. there is no such thing as
happiness); क्व — क्व or कुत्र — क्व implies ex-
cessive incongruity, where is this? where is that?
how distant is this from that, how little does this
agree with that (e. g. क्व शूर्य-प्रभवो वंशः
क्व च अल्प-विषया मतिः, how can my limited
intellect describe the solar race?); क्वापि (क्व अपि),
[]
anywhere, somewhere, to some place, to any place,
in a certain place; sometimes; क्व च, anywhere,
somewhere, at any time; क्व च न, anywhere
(originally negative); न क्वचन, nowhere; क्व-
चिद्, anywhere, somewhere, to any place, in a certain
place; in a certain case, sometimes; at some time,
once upon a time; क्वचिद् — क्वचिद्, here — there,
here and there, in various places; now — then, now
and then; न क्वचिद्, nowhere, never, by no means;
यत्र क्वापि or यत्र क्वच, wherever, whereso-
ever, to whatsoever place, anywhere; यत्र क्व-
चन, to whatsoever place, hither and thither, any-
where; whenever, at any time, when, in any case or
matter whatever; यत्र क्व वाथ — तत्र तत्रापि,
wherever — there.
—क्व-जन्मन्, आ, आ, अ, where
born?
—क्व-निवास, अस्, आ, अम्, where dwelling?

क्वत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, or क्वत्यक, अस्, इका, अम्,
of or belonging to where or what place? being
where?

क्वङ्गु क्वङ्गु, उस्, m. = कङ्गु, a sort of
Panic, Panicum Italicum.

क्वण् क्वण्, cl. 1. P. क्वणति, चक्वाण,
क्वणितुम्, to sound; to hum (as a bee);
to make any sound; to tinkle: Caus. क्वणयति,
यितुम्, to cause to sound, to make sound, to twang,
to produce a sound with anything; e. g. नूपुरैः,
with anklet ornaments; [cf. Lat. cano; Goth. hana,
‘a cock.’]

क्वण, अस्, m. the sound or tone of any musical
instrument; sound in general.

क्वाण, अस्, m. the sound of a musical instrument;
sound in general.
क्वणत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, sounding.

क्वणन, अम्, n. sounding, the sound of any
musical instrument; (अस्), m. a small earthen pot or
boiler.

क्वणित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, twanged (as a
stringed instrument); (अम्), n. sound, twang.

क्वथ् क्वथ्, cl. 1. P. क्वथति, चक्वाथ,
क्वथिष्यति, अक्वथीत्, क्वथितुम्, to
boil, stew, decoct, prepare by heat; to digest: Caus.
क्वाथयति, -यितुम्, to cause to boil, to boil, decoct.
क्वथ, अस्, m. a decoction, an extract.

क्वाथ, अस्, m. a decoction, any solution or infusion
prepared with a continued or gentle heat; the mixture
of the materials for a decoction; pain, sorrow, cala-
mity, distress.
—क्वाथोद्भव (˚थ-उद्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, produced by boiling; (अम्), n. blue vitriol used
as a collyrium.
क्वथन, अम्, n. boiling, decocting.

क्वथित, अस्, आ, अम्, boiled, decocted, stewed,
digested.

क्वधःस्थ क्व्-अधः-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 2. कु-
अधस्-स्थ), Ved. standing below on the earth.
क्वयि क्वयि, इस्, m., Ved. a kind of bird.

क्वल क्वल, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), Ved. a
substance used for coagulating other substances.

क्वाचित्क क्वाचित्क, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. क्व-चित्),
met with somewhere or occasionally; rare, un-
common.

क्वाथि क्वाथि, इस्, m., Ved. an epithet of
Agastya.
क्वापि क्वापि, ind. somewhere, &c. See क्व.
